description: An unterminated display-text literal in a state-child body is E-CTX-001 at its opening `"`, recovered at the body's closer — even when a later `"` in the file would close it — with no E-UNQUOTED-DISPLAY-TEXT / E-PARSE-UNCLOSED cascade.
rationale: §4.18.3: "A display-text literal that reaches end-of-file (or the body's closer) before its closing `"` is an unterminated literal — `E-CTX-001` against the opening `"`, recovered per §4.18.7."
